## Summary

What does this change and why? Link the issue it closes, for example `Closes #123`.

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Refactor or tooling
- [ ] Breaking change

## How was it tested?

Describe what you ran. For anything visual or performance related, include the device, browser and a screenshot or frame rate reading.

## Checklist

- [ ] CI passes and I ran lint, typecheck, test and build locally where they exist
- [ ] Tests added or updated
- [ ] Docs updated, and `CHANGELOG.md` has a line under Unreleased
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, personal location data or private URLs
- [ ] No third party copyrighted material, and any new dependency is listed in `docs/THIRD_PARTY.md`
- [ ] The app still runs with no API keys
- [ ] Does not write to vehicle firmware, braking or other critical systems

## AI assistance

- [ ] This change was substantially generated with AI tools. I have read, run and understood all of it.
